headline: Noah Reports Q3 Results with International AUM Up 10.7% in USD
summary: Noah Holdings reported its third-quarter results, showing international registered clients and assets under management up 10.7% year-over-year in USD terms, marking its 64th consecutive quarter of non-GAAP profitability.
why: Noah Holdings is a wealth management service provider catering to global Chinese clients, listed on the NYSE and HKEX.

impacts.name: Noah Holdings
impacts.why: The company released its quarterly financial results.
